title: A trainer: data/trainers/<trainer>.json
description: A trainer's record (archive a/0/9/1, 20 bytes) and its party (a/0/9/2). tools/data/trainer_data.py packs them in the order of data/constants/trainers.txt. A string value is the name of a constant from data/constants/ or include/constants/.

name.description: The trainer's name, which the text files take with \from{trainers.name}

compress_name.description: Left out, the name is stored compressed, as the game stores almost every trainer's; false for the few it doesn't

battle_style.description: Single, double, triple or rotation battle, a BTL_STYLE_* constant

items.description: Up to four items the trainer can use in battle

ai_flags.description: The trainer AI scripts to run, AI_FLAG_* constants (see docs/scripts.md)

money.description: A multiplier of the prize money

reward.description: An item given after the battle

messages.description: What the trainer says, in order: lines of system message file 381, which the text files take with \from{trainers.messages}, and the trainer message table pairs with the trainer and their type. data/trainers/message_order.json gives the order of the trainers in the table

type.description: When the trainer says it: TRMSG_START before the battle, TRMSG_LOSE when it loses, TRMSG_WIN when it wins, and other moments by number

text.description: The message, with its line breaks

party.description: The party. Every Pokémon has an item if any has, which makes it a party with items, and moves if any has, which makes it a party with moves; without moves, a Pokémon gets the moves of its level
